description.en: Generic glacier-serac source-art correction limited to the fixed northeast and southwest channel junctions. The bounded local changes weaken grid-like junction readings while preserving the remaining source geometry and nominal 30 × 30 m footprint. This is not a full-field naturalization, named glacier, age or measured hazard/ice-dynamics simulation. Host integration, collision and physical GPU performance remain separate unverified concerns.
description.zh: 通用冰塔源美术修正版，仅修改固定东北和西南沟道交汇局部，以弱化交点网格读感，其余源几何及名义30×30米占地保留。不是整片地形自然化、特定冰川、年代或实测危险性/冰动力模拟；宿主整合、碰撞与物理GPU性能仍待各自验证。

limits: PASS binds only this exact fixed candidate, not any later revision.
No automatic qualification-count increase, release, GitHub upload, merge, publication or deployment.
No hardware GPU, target scene, terrain seams, collision, navigation, LOD or production world-host acceptance claimed.
No retry, new Research/Maker dispatch, or budget renewal.
original_scoped_statements.summary: 独立技术及固定视觉验收通过。局部 NE/SW 交汇错位在 512/256 均清晰可见，值得保留；塔体、低槽陡壁连续性与源拓扑/材质/场景保持。仅此 sealed candidate 的合同内 PASS，不是发布或 world-host/GPU/物理批准。

source_limits: Fixed local anti-grid standalone asset only; no user visual acceptance, GPU, world host, integration or deployment claim
